summary: iter413co Batch 1 (Loretta's seller feedback) — verified category-aware Technique dropdown + Custom→Other rename. Ran 18 module-level contract tests against /app/frontend/src/lib/techniqueOptions.js (all PASS) + static code inspection of NewListingModal, MakerListingEditor, ApplyPage, BetaPage, and checkout.py. Implementation matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: constants.js extension-less import `from "../../lib/techniqueOptions"` works fine in Webpack/Babel runtime but is not Node-ESM-strict; not a runtime bug for the app but blocks vanilla `node` dev scripts (worked around with regex parse in test script).

SHIPPING_BY_CATEGORY in backend/routers/checkout.py does NOT include keys for Glass / Paper Crafts / Mixed Media — by design they fall back to DEFAULT_SHIPPING=$30. Spec accepts this, but the editor's SHIPPING_DEFAULTS map (constants.js) also has no entry for these three, so the SHIPPING_FALLBACK ($30) is correctly applied. Consider adding explicit entries later if Loretta wants tighter rates for fiber/paper (lighter goods).
NewListingModal.jsx mixes `import { useMemo }` and `React.useEffect` (line 75) — minor style inconsistency, not a bug.
test_credentials: iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org — minted via maker_auth.issue_magic_token; JWT verified via POST /api/maker/auth/verify (200).
